dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL, converted by COBOL Conversion Aid PO 5785-ABJ (IBM product), fixed format, VMOD=2.011, authored by Logic Inc., Dallas TX. Uses BLOCK CONTAINS 0, RECORDING MODE F, INDEXED file with FILE STATUS, EJECT directives, and COMP/COMP-3 fields typical of IBM mainframe environment.

purpose.domain_detail: Reinsurance claims register printing - prints claim register of reinsured claims (ITD/YTD/MTD paid claims) for insurance carrier companies
purpose.summary: ECS029E prints a Reinsured Claims Register report. It reads claim extract files, sorts them, looks up reinsurance company table data, and produces formatted printed reports showing paid reinsured claims filtered by inception-to-date, year-to-date, or month-to-date based on a program parameter (DTE-PGM-PIC 029).

notable_features: INDEXED file access with FILE STATUS
COPY statements for FD definitions (ECSEXTFD, ECSEXT01, ELCDTEFD, ELCPRTFD, ELCFCHFD, ERCREIN)
BLANK WHEN ZERO on numeric edited fields
Reinsurance company table with OCCURS 1500 TIMES
Year 2000 compliance review noted in comments
37 GOTO statements indicating older structured style
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full PROCEDURE DIVISION not visible but mechanical indicators show 753 lines total with 28 PERFORMs and 37 GOTOs suggesting a substantial batch report program. Program was converted from an older COBOL dialect by IBM COBOL Conversion Aid in 1996 and reviewed for Y2K compliance. The 'ECS' prefix and Logic Inc. authorship suggest a commercial insurance software package.
